name: Pralino Classic Patisserie
summary: A classic, editorial pâtisserie: white and soft-tint bands, near-black ink, a sage accent, Cormorant Garamond over Mulish and large photography. A white header with a centred serif wordmark drawn from the shop's live title; a hero where the counter photo bleeds to the edge with a framed inset across the seam and the most-ordered collections on its dark corner; the shop in numbers and its story; the four best-selling collections as photo rows; how ordering works; an offer card with the ways to receive an order; a gallery of the collections; today's selection as numbered rows; a full-width photo band; a marquee of the collections and the journal. One colour family follows the chosen palette (Tan, Rose, Sage, Slate, Ink or a custom colour) and one small-radius shape language runs through every page; light by default, with a dark mode, from the footer's Theme row.
